Digital Marketing Specialist - Hyderabad, Telangana

We're looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to own paid campaigns and content strategy for our D2C brand.

REQUIREMENTS
- 3+ years experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns
- Strong understanding of SEO and Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- Experience with email marketing tools such as Mailchimp
- MBA in Marketing or equivalent experience preferred

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Manage monthly ad spend across Google and Meta
- Run A/B tests on landing pages
- Report on campaign performance weekly

NICE TO HAVE
- Google Ads certification, HubSpot certification
